highlight.text: Points for Nejmeh. Quarter-final hopes rest on other results.

caption:
Nejmeh beat Al Arabi 3-1 in the AFC Challenge League, coming from behind on matchday 3. ⚽

The win takes Nejmeh to six points in Group B. Their place in the quarter-finals now rests on other results: in the West Region only the three group winners and the best runner-up go through.

Who was your man of the match? 🇱🇧

📸 AFC
Source: AFC
@nejmeh_sc
#SportsWireLB #LebaneseFootball
